  nts/2026-08-01"]; out=[]; bad=("phone","email","user","login","name","fio","passport","address","comment","token");
  for p in paths:
   e=yt.exists(p); d={"path":p,"exists":bool(e)}
   if e:
    s=yt.get(p+"/@schema"); d["schema_columns"]=[x.get("name") for x in s if not any(b in x.get("name","").lower() for b in bad)][:30];
  d["row_count"]=yt.get(p+"/@row_count") if yt.exists(p+"/@row_count") else None
   out.append(d)
  print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,default=str))'
